body:
Synthetic Ecosystem Foundry. Designs contained, testable biological communities for applications such as waste processing, agriculture, or ecosystem restoration.

This database covers the technology as item 211 entry 59 of Manon's "100 Ultra-Advanced Future Technologies" catalog, section "Medicine, Biology, and Designed Life Systems". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. Synthetic microbial communities work in bioreactors; designed ecosystems for open applications are early.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Synthetic Ecosystem Foundry - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Designs contained, testable biological communities for applications such as waste processing, agriculture, or ecosystem restoration.
body:
Known science foundations of Synthetic Ecosystem Foundry.

Synthetic consortia degrade pollutants and produce chemicals in bioreactors. Soil microbiome engineering improves crops in trials. Algal-bacterial systems treat wastewater. JCVI and others design minimal communities. Open-environment release faces ecological and regulatory barriers.

Key quantity check (Microbial species in a gram of soil / species in a designed consortium): computed ratio 100000000 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.3. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Synthetic Ecosystem Foundry - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Designs contained, testable biological communities for applications such as waste processing, agriculture, or ecosystem restoration.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Synthetic Ecosystem Foundry.

Designed communities are invaded by wild microbes. Ecosystem behavior is hard to predict. Release regulations are strict for good reason.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 8 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is natural diversity vs designed diversity at 8 orders of magnitude (natural diversity larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

title: Synthetic Ecosystem Foundry - Unresolved Problems
description: Public edition: Designs contained, testable biological communities for applications such as waste processing, agriculture, or ecosystem restoration.
body:
Unresolved problems for Synthetic Ecosystem Foundry, in priority order (research burden index 30, 3 blocking):

Stability in open environments (severity 3/3, tractability 1/3, BLOCKING; priority 12).

Predicting community dynamics (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Safe, reversible deployment (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.

body:
What would count as evidence of success for Synthetic Ecosystem Foundry:

Consortium persists 90 days in a mesocosm (weight 0.4; SATISFIED).

Outperforms monoculture on a task (weight 0.35; SATISFIED).

Approved field trial (weight 0.25; not yet satisfied).
